headlines.text: That Saturday in 2022, the ROH World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Claudio Castagnoli vs. Konosuke Takeshita went to war, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 8.98 ? a genuine showstealer. For Claudio Castagnoli and Konosuke Takeshita, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Takeshita, still building his reputation through tough losses to AEW's biggest names, pushed Castagnoli to the brink before a Ricola Bomb settled a match many called a true show-stealer.

Back on this day in 2025, Kyle Fletcher vs. Tomohiro Ishii delivered one of the better matches of the year on Collision, rated 8.14. In his first defense since dethroning Rhodes, Fletcher weathered Ishii's brutal chops to retain the TNT Championship.
Back on this day in 2025, Brodido vs. The Young Bucks met in a Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? an excellent showing.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.17.
Rewind to 2025, when MJF vs. Mark Briscoe headlined Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

2022 brought us this moment: Thunder Rosa vs. Jamie Hayter went to battle over the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.85. For Jamie Hayter, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
